create.title: Odd-character level-four/eight Kuznetsov and joint-matrix source audit
create.statement_tex: Kiral--Young arXiv:1710.00914 Theorem 2.7 and (2.20) assume an even character in a weight-zero setting and do not certify chi_4 or a weight-one switched-cusp trace formula. Blomer--Milicevic arXiv:1410.4538 equation (2.3), at q=q_1=4, gives sum_(n odd) chi_4(n)S(N_0,h;n)omega(n)=chi_4(M_0)/tau(chi_4) times the level-4 sum minus the level-8 sum of S_chi4(M_0,16uh;C)omega(C/4), where u=2^v_2(N_0), M_0=N_0/u, and tau(chi_4)=2i. Its legal parity is kappa=1 and its same-sign spectral ledger is H+M+E: odd holomorphic weights at least 3, all weight-one Maass parameters including exceptional and t=0 if present, and Eisenstein terms over every singular cusp. Level 4 has singular cusps infinity and 0 and no proper-level oldspace for primitive conductor four; level 8 has four singular cusps and level-4 oldclasses. The printed fixed-argument Linnik estimate requires one fixed arithmetic weight, one fixed compact smooth test, positive indices, and mn at most the squared modulus scale. Deshouillers--Iwaniec requires a fixed cusp and one common sequence in its spectral large sieves; Assing--Blomer--Li permits one sequence times a jointly smooth two-variable test under explicit support, derivative, coprimality, and scale hypotheses, but contains neither the chi_4 modulus twist nor the level-4/8 encoding. None of these audited statements accepts the project's literal joint modulus-frequency matrix with an owner-saving norm supplied by the frozen controls.
create.next_action: Use the Blomer--Milicevic identity only with its complete level-4/8, fixed-test, weight-one H+M+E ledger. Do not cite Kiral--Young for odd chi_4, transplant unsupported opposite-sign constants, omit level-8 oldclasses or cusps, or infer an arbitrary joint-matrix theorem from the scalar large sieves.

create.title: Exact odd-character cusp embedding and joint spectral-matrix obstruction
create.statement_tex: For the frozen flat-smooth strict-UNBAL owner, with Gamma_0(4), primitive chi_4, kappa=1, cusps (infinity,0), sigma_infinity=I, and sigma_0=((0,-1/2),(2,0)), the allowed generalized moduli are exactly 2n with n odd and S^(chi_4)_(infinity,0)(4N_0,h;2n)=chi_4(n)S(N_0,h;n) for every h and every gcd (N_0,n), with no modulus-dependent root in the fixed convention. After r=gn and k=gj, the full owner is sum_(g,n odd,gn~R)chi_4(g)W(X/(gnD))sum_(h mod n)gammahat_(g,n)(h)S^(chi_4)_(infinity,0)(4N_0,h;2n), retaining all gcd strata, profiles, endpoints, and the real-centre phase. The h=0 contribution is O_epsilon(X^epsilon), so the strict survivor is the centered h nonzero matrix. Row Parseval gives ||A_g||_(S2)^2 << X^epsilon/(gK) and ||A_g||_(S1) << sqrt(Delta)X^epsilon/g; the conditional 2n cross-cusp and sourced 4n standard-cusp samples have automatic norms ||B_g||_(S2) << sqrt(R Delta)X^epsilon/g^(3/2) and ||B_g||_(S1) << R sqrt(Delta)X^epsilon/g^2. These are upper prices only. The frozen data prove no owner-saving common smooth test, common sequence, or vector-valued norm for the literal matrix. The same-sign Linnik comparison scale is H_Lin(g)~X/(D^2g^2)=K/(Lg^2), with discrete coverage at most 1/(Dg) of the row and no nonzero frequency for g much larger than sqrt(K/L); Parseval gives no localization and no audited complementary-range theorem applies. The exact complete Kloosterman second moment yields only R sqrt(Delta)X^epsilon=X^(1-(delta+ell)/2+epsilon), worse than both accepted-envelope branches throughout the strict polytope. Expanding gammahat and summing h returns the original reciprocal row exactly. This is a scoped insufficiency result for the frozen controls, not a signed lower bound or a no-go for a new literal-matrix theorem.
